title.raw: 卷三十二 本紀第三十二 高宗九 Volume 32 Annals 32: Gaozong 9

value.zh: 卷八十四 翟方進傳第五十四
value.en: Volume 84, the fifty-fourth biography: Zhai Fangjin.
value.literal: Volume 84, Biography the Fifty-Fourth: Zhai Fangjin.

value.zh: 初，三輔聞翟義起，自茂陵以西至□二十三縣盜賊並發，趙明、霍鴻等自稱將軍，攻燒官寺，殺右輔都尉及□令，劫略吏民，眾十餘萬，火見未央宮前殿。
value.en: When Yi rebelled, from Maoling west through twenty-three counties the capital region erupted: Zhao Ming and Huo Hong declared themselves generals, torched yamen, slew metropolitan deputies and magistrates, looted towns, and gathered more than a hundred thousand men until flames lit the sky before Weiyang Palace.
value.literal: At first, when the Three Adjuncts heard Zhai Yi had risen, from Maoling west to □ twenty-three counties bandits rose together; Zhao Ming, Huo Hong, and others styled themselves generals, attacked and burned government offices, killed the capital-region deputy and □ magistrate, plundered officials and commoners—the host was more than a hundred thousand; fire was seen before Weiyang Palace's front hall.

value.zh: 莽晝夜抱孺子禱宗廟。
value.en: Mang day and night clutched the boy emperor and prayed in the shrines of his ancestors.
value.literal: Mang day and night embraced the infant and prayed in the ancestral shrines.

value.zh: 復拜衛尉王級為虎賁將軍，大鴻臚望鄉侯閻遷為折衝將軍，與甄邯、王晏西擊趙明等。
value.en: He named Wang Ji, commandant of the guards, Tiger Fury general, and Yan Qian, Marquis of Wangxiang, as Assault general, and sent them with Zhen Han and Wang Yan west against Zhao Ming.
value.literal: Again he appointed Commandant of the Guards Wang Ji as Tiger Fury general, Grand Herald Marquis of Wangxiang Yan Qian as Assault general, together with Zhen Han and Wang Yan to strike Zhao Ming and others from the west.

value.zh: 正月，虎牙將軍王邑等自關東還，便引兵西。
value.en: In the first month Wang Yi, Tiger Fang general, marched back from the east and at once turned his column west.
value.literal: In the first month, Tiger Fang general Wang Yi and others returned from east of the passes and thereupon led troops west.

value.zh: 強弩將軍王駿以無功免，揚武將軍劉歆歸故官。
value.en: Wang Jun lost his post as Strong Crossbow general for failure; Liu Xin went back to his old portfolio as general displaying martial prowess.
value.literal: Strong Crossbow general Wang Jun was dismissed for lacking merit; General Who Displays Martial Prowess Liu Xin returned to his former office.

value.zh: 復以邑弟侍中王奇為揚武將軍，城門將軍趙恢為強弩將軍，中郎將李□為厭難將軍，復將兵西。
value.en: Wang Yi's brother Wang Qi, a palace attendant, was named general displaying martial prowess; Zhao Hui became Strong Crossbow general; a Gentleman Li □ took the Hardship-quelling title, and the western column marched again.
value.literal: Again he made Yi's younger brother, attendant Wang Qi, General Who Displays Martial Prowess, Gate general Zhao Hui Strong Crossbow general, Gentleman of the Palace Li □ Hardship-quelling general, and again led troops west.

value.zh: 二月，明等殄滅，諸縣悉平，還師振旅。
value.en: By the second month Zhao Ming's band was destroyed, every county was quiet, and the host marched home in good order.
value.literal: In the second month Ming and the others were wiped out; all counties were pacified; the army returned and shook the ranks.

value.zh: 莽乃置酒白虎殿，勞饗將帥，大封拜。
value.en: Mang then held a banquet in the White Tiger Hall for his generals, heaped rewards on them, and handed out a fresh round of titles.
value.literal: Mang thereupon set wine in the White Tiger Hall, feasted and rewarded generals and commanders, and greatly invested and appointed.

value.zh: 先是，益州蠻夷及金城塞外羌反畔，時州郡擊破之。
value.en: Earlier the Yi tribesmen and the Jincheng Qiang beyond the wall had risen; provincial troops had already beaten them down.
value.literal: Earlier, the barbarians of Yi commandery and the Qiang beyond the barrier of Jincheng had rebelled; at the time commanderies and states had crushed them.

value.zh: 莽乃並隸，以小大為差，封侯、伯、子、男凡三百九十五人，曰「皆以奮怒，東指西擊，羌寇蠻盜，反虜逆賊，不得旋踵，應時殄滅，天下咸服」之功封雲。
value.en: Wang Mang then grouped these campaigns together and graded the awards by importance, enfeoffing 395 men as marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons. He declared that they were rewarded for the merit of having "roused themselves in anger, struck east and west, and destroyed Qiang raiders, Man bandits, rebel captives, and traitorous thieves before they could even turn on their heels, so that all under heaven submitted."
value.literal: Mang thereupon combined and subsumed them, by great and small as gradation, enfeoffing marquises, earls, viscounts, and barons—three hundred ninety-five persons in all—saying "all by raging anger, pointing east and striking west, Qiang raiders and Man bandits, rebel captives and traitorous thieves, could not turn heel; they were wiped out in season, and the realm all submitted"—merit for enfeoffment was thus declared.

value.zh: 莽於是自謂大得天人之助，至其年十二月，遂即真矣。
value.en: Convinced that Heaven and humanity favored him, in the twelfth month of that year he took the throne in his own name.
value.literal: Mang thereupon deemed himself greatly to have obtained Heaven and man's aid; reaching that year's twelfth month, he thereupon assumed the true position.

value.zh: 愍懷太子
value.en: Crown Prince Minhuai
value.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai

value.zh: 太子性剛，知賈謐恃後之貴，不能假借之。
value.en: Yu refused to flatter Jia Mi.
value.literal: The crown prince's temper was stiff; knowing Jia Mi relied on the empress's power, he would not indulge him.

value.zh: 謐至東宮，或舍之而於後庭遊戲。
value.en: He left Jia Mi cooling heels while he played inside.
value.literal: When Mi came to the Eastern Palace he sometimes left him waiting while he played in the inner courts.

value.zh: 詹事裴權諫曰：「賈謐甚有寵于中宮，而有不順之色，若一旦交構，大事去矣。
value.en: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: "Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.
value.literal: Household Superintendent Pei Quan remonstrated: 'Jia Mi is deeply favored in the inner palace yet shows disrespectful looks—if they ever turn on you, the great enterprise is lost.

value.zh: 宜深自謙屈，以防其變，廣延賢士，用自輔翼。」
value.en: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings."
value.literal: You should humble yourself deeply to guard against change and broadly recruit worthy men to aid your wings.'

value.zh: 太子不能從。
value.en: Yu ignored him.
value.literal: The crown prince would not follow.

value.zh: 初，賈后母郭槐欲以韓壽女為太子妃，太子亦欲婚韓氏以自固。
value.en: Guo Huai once pushed a Han match—Yu wanted it too.
value.literal: Earlier Empress Jia's mother Guo Huai had wished to take Han Shou's daughter as crown princess; the crown prince also wished to marry the Hans to strengthen himself.

value.zh: 而壽妻賈午及後皆不聽，而為太子聘王衍小女惠風。
value.en: Jia Wu and the empress forced Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng instead.
value.literal: But Han Shou's wife Jia Wu and the empress both refused and instead betrothed the crown prince to Wang Yan's younger daughter Huifeng.

value.zh: 太子聞衍長女美，而賈后為謐聘之，心不能平，頗以為言。
value.en: Yu resented losing Wang's elder beauty to Jia Mi.
value.literal: The crown prince heard Wang's elder daughter was beautiful while the empress betrothed her to Jia Mi; his heart could not rest easy and he spoke of it often.

value.zh: 謐嘗與太子圍棋，爭道，成都王穎見而訶謐，謐意愈不平，因此譖太子于後曰：「太子廣買田業，多畜私財以結小人者，為賈氏故也。
value.en: Once while playing go with the crown prince Mi quarreled over a move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and slandered the crown prince to the empress: "The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.
value.literal: Once Mi played go with the crown prince and they quarreled over the move; Ying, Prince of Chengdu, saw and rebuked Mi; Mi grew more resentful and therefore slandered the crown prince to the empress: 'The crown prince buys fields wholesale, hoards private wealth, and courts petty men—all because of the Jia clan.

value.zh: 密聞其言云：'皇后萬歲後，吾當魚肉之。
value.en: Mi quoted Yu vowing to slaughter the Jias after Jia died.
value.literal: I have secretly heard him say: "After the empress dies, I shall butcher them."

value.zh: '非但如是也，若宮車晏駕，彼居大位，依楊氏故事，誅臣等而廢後於金墉，如反手耳。
value.en: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.
value.literal: Not only that—if the imperial carriage halts and he reaches the great seat, following Lady Yang's precedent he will execute us ministers and lock you away at Jinyong like turning his hand.

value.zh: 不如早為之所，更立慈順者以自防衛。」
value.en: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves."
value.literal: Better strike early, remove him, and set up someone kindly and tractable to defend ourselves.'

value.zh: 後納其言，又宣揚太子之短，布諸遠近。
value.en: Jia adopted the plot and smeared Yu empire-wide.
value.literal: The empress accepted his words and further broadcast the crown prince's faults throughout near and far.

value.zh: 于時朝野咸知賈后有害太子意。
value.en: Everyone saw Jia meant to kill the heir.
value.literal: Then court and countryside knew the empress meant to harm the crown prince.

value.zh: 中護軍趙俊請太子廢後，太子不聽。
value.en: Zhao Jun urged preemptive deposition—Yu declined.
value.literal: Central Guard Zhao Jun asked the crown prince to depose the empress first; the crown prince refused.

value.zh: 初，太子之廢也，妃父王衍表請離婚。
value.en: Wang Yan filed for divorce the moment Yu fell.
value.literal: When the crown prince was first deposed, his father-in-law Wang Yan memorialized requesting divorce.

value.zh: 太子至許，遺妃書曰：「鄙雖頑愚，心念為善，欲盡忠孝之節，無有惡逆之心。
value.en: After reaching Xu he sent his consort a letter: "Though I am coarse and foolish, at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.
value.literal: After the crown prince reached Xu he sent his consort a letter: 'Though I am coarse and foolish at heart I wished to do good and fulfill loyalty and filial piety—I harbored no rebellious evil.

value.zh: 雖非中宮所生，奉事有如親母。
value.en: He claimed dutiful service to Jia despite birth.
value.literal: Though not born of the inner palace I served her as my own mother.

value.zh: 自為太子以來，敕見禁檢，不得見母。
value.en: Palace rules barred him from Lady Xie.
value.literal: Since becoming crown prince edicts confined me—I could not see my mother.

value.zh: 自宜城君亡，不見存恤，恆在空室中坐。
value.en: Since the Lady of Yicheng died I received no comforting word—I constantly sat alone in empty rooms.
value.literal: Since the Lady of Yicheng died I received no comforting word—I constantly sat alone in empty rooms.

value.zh: 去年十二月，道文疾病困篤，父子之情，實相憐湣。
value.en: Last twelfth month Daowen became gravely ill; the affection between father and son made us deeply pity one another.
value.literal: Last twelfth month Daowen's illness grew desperate—father and son pitied each other truly.

value.zh: 于時表國家乞加徽號，不見聽許。
value.en: His plea for son's title failed.
value.literal: Then I petitioned the throne for honors—permission never came.

value.zh: 疾病既篤，為之求請恩福，無有噁心。
value.en: He denied malice in praying for the boy.
value.literal: When illness grew grave I sought blessings for him—I bore no evil intent.

value.zh: 自道文病，中宮三遣左右來視，云：'天教呼汝。
value.en: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."
value.literal: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."

value.zh: '到二十八日暮，有短函來，題言東宮發，疏云：'言天教欲見汝。
value.en: On the evening of the twenty-eighth a short letter arrived, marked as a dispatch from the Eastern Palace. It said, "His Majesty wishes to see you."
value.literal: On the evening of the twenty-eighth a short letter arrived, marked as a dispatch from the Eastern Palace. It said, "His Majesty wishes to see you."

value.zh: '即便作表求入。
value.en: He requested audience.
value.literal: At once I drafted a memorial begging entry.

value.zh: 二十九日早入見國家，須臾遣至中宮。
value.en: He saw Hui briefly then reached Jia's halls.
value.literal: On the twenty-ninth morning I entered and saw His Majesty; presently I was sent to the inner palace.

value.zh: 中宮左右陳舞見語：'中宮旦來吐不快。
value.en: Chen Wu claimed Jia was sick.
value.literal: Inner attendants Chen Wu told him: 'The empress vomited ill this morning.'

value.zh: '使住空屋中坐。
value.en: They parked him in an empty room.
value.literal: She told you to wait seated in an empty chamber.

value.zh: 須臾中宮遣陳舞見語：'聞汝表陛下為道文乞王，不得王是成國耳。
value.en: Presently the empress sent Chen Wu to tell me: 'I hear you petitioned His Majesty to make Daowen a prince and were refused. A princely title means a territorial domain, after all.'
value.literal: Presently the empress sent Chen Wu to tell me: 'I hear you petitioned His Majesty to make Daowen a prince and were refused. A princely title means a territorial domain, after all.'

value.zh: '中宮遙呼陳舞：'昨天教與太子酒棗。
value.en: The empress called to Chen Wu from a distance: "Yesterday His Majesty ordered wine and jujubes for the crown prince."
value.literal: The empress called to Chen Wu from a distance: "Yesterday His Majesty ordered wine and jujubes for the crown prince."

value.zh: '便持三升酒、大盤棗來見與，使飲酒啖棗盡。
value.en: Chen Wu forced three sheng wine and dates.
value.literal: She brought three sheng of ale and a great tray of jujubes and made him finish both.

value.zh: 鄙素不飲酒，即便遣舞啟說不堪三升之意。
value.en: Yu pleaded low tolerance.
value.literal: I never drink ale yet sent Chen Wu back explaining I could not manage three sheng.

value.zh: 中宮遙呼曰：'汝常陛下前持酒可喜，何以不飲？
value.en: The empress called from a distance: 'You are always so pleasing when you hold wine before His Majesty; why will you not drink?'
value.literal: The empress called from a distance: 'You are always so pleasing when you hold wine before His Majesty; why will you not drink?'

value.zh: 天與汝酒，當使道文差也。
value.en: His Majesty has given you wine; it should make Daowen recover.
value.literal: His Majesty has given you wine; it should make Daowen recover.

value.zh: '便答中宮：'陛下會同一日見賜，故不敢辭，通日不飲三升酒也。
value.en: Yu cited earlier imperial banquet.
value.literal: I answered the inner palace: His Majesty granted ale one day—therefore I dared not refuse—but all day I never drank three sheng.

value.zh: 且實未食，恐不堪。
value.en: Empty stomach worried him.
value.literal: Moreover I had not eaten—I feared I could not endure it.

value.zh: 又未見殿下，飲此或至顛倒。
value.en: Besides, I had not yet seen Your Highness, and drinking this might leave me confused and unsteady.
value.literal: Nor had I yet seen Your Highness—I feared drink might overturn me.

value.zh: '陳舞復傳語云：'不孝那！
value.en: Chen Wu called him unfilial.
value.literal: Chen Wu relayed another message: "You unfilial wretch!

value.zh: 天與汝酒飲，不肯飲，中有惡物邪？
value.en: His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?
value.literal: His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?

value.zh: '遂可飲二升，餘有一升，求持還東宮飲盡。
value.en: I then managed to drink two sheng. With one sheng left, I asked to take it back to the Eastern Palace and finish it there.
value.literal: I then managed to drink two sheng. With one sheng left, I asked to take it back to the Eastern Palace and finish it there.

value.zh: 逼迫不得已，更飲一升。
value.en: Cornered he drank more.
value.literal: Pressed helplessly he drank another sheng.

value.zh: 飲已，體中荒迷，不復自覺。
value.en: After drinking it, I became dazed and lost awareness.
value.literal: After drinking his body grew confused and he lost awareness.

value.zh: 須臾有一小婢持封箱來，云：'詔使寫此文書。
value.en: Presently a young maid brought a sealed case and said, "The emperor orders you to copy this document."
value.literal: Presently a young maid brought a sealed case, saying, 'The edict orders you to write out this document.'

value.zh: '鄙便驚起，視之，有一白紙，一青紙。
value.en: He found white and green paper inside.
value.literal: I started in alarm and looked: there was one sheet of white paper and one of green.

value.zh: 催促云：'陛下停待。
value.en: Runners said the emperor waited.
value.literal: They pressed: 'His Majesty is waiting.'

value.zh: '又小婢承福持筆研墨黃紙來，使寫。
value.en: Chengfu added brush and yellow paper for the copy.
value.literal: Another small maid, Chengfu, brought brush, inkstone, and yellow paper, making him write.

value.zh: 急疾不容復視，實不覺紙上語輕重。
value.en: Rush left no time to read the forgery's sense.
value.literal: Haste would not let me reread; I truly did not notice the import of the words on the page.

value.zh: 父母至親，實不相疑，事理如此，實為見誣，想眾人見明也。」
value.en: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'
value.literal: Parents are kin closest of all—I truly did not doubt them; though matters went so, I have been slandered, and I trust the multitude will see it clear.'

value.zh: 三十一年春正月甲戌朔，以日食，不受朝。
value.en: Year 31, spring, jiaxu new moon: Gaozong canceled audience for the eclipse.
value.literal: Thirty-first year, spring, first month, day jiaxu new moon: because of a solar eclipse, court audience was not held.

value.zh: 丁丑，雷。
value.en: On dingchou, thunder rolled.
value.literal: Day dingchou: thunder.

value.zh: 丁亥，免湖州增丁所輸絹。
value.en: On dinghai, Huzhou was freed from added-household silk levies.
value.literal: Day dinghai: the silk paid by Huzhou for added registered households was remitted.

value.zh: 夜，風雷雨雪交作。
value.en: That night wind, thunder, snow, and rain came together.
value.literal: At night, wind, thunder, snow, and rain struck together.

value.zh: 辛卯，詔江、浙官民戶均輸和市絁帛。
value.en: On xinmao, Jiang and Zhe were told to share silk transport and market purchases equally among official and common households.
value.literal: Day xinmao: an edict ordered official and common households of Jiang and Zhe to share equally in transport and market purchase of silk.

value.zh: 壬辰，劉寶落節鉞、福建路居住。
value.en: On renchen, Liu Bao lost his command tally and was sent to live on the Fujian circuit.
value.literal: Day renchen: Liu Bao was stripped of his command tally and made to reside on the Fujian circuit.

value.zh: 丙申，大雨雪，給三衙衛士、行在貧民錢及薪炭，命常平振給輔郡細民，諸路監司決獄。
value.en: On bingchen, heavy snow brought cash and charcoal to palace guards and capital poor; Ever-Normal stores fed nearby counties; commissioners judged cases.
value.literal: Day bingchen: in great rain and snow, money and fuel were given to the Three Yamaz guards and poor people at the mobile court; the Ever-Normal Granaries were ordered to relieve needy folk in auxiliary commanderies; circuit commissioners were to decide cases.

value.zh: 己亥，放張浚、胡銓自便。
value.en: On jihai, Zhang Jun and Hu Quan were freed to their own devices.
value.literal: Day jihai: Zhang Jun and Hu Quan were released to go as they pleased.

value.zh: 庚子，禁淮南拘籍戶馬。
value.en: On gengzi, Huainan could no longer seize and register civilian horses.
value.literal: Day gengzi: Huainan was forbidden to seize and register household horses.

value.zh: 冬十月庚子朔，詔將親征。
value.en: Tenth month, gengzi new moon: Gaozong announced he would take the field.
value.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi new moon: an edict said the Emperor would campaign in person.

value.zh: 魏勝攻沂州，敗，還海州，金人圍之。
value.en: Wei Sheng attacked Yizhou, lost, fled to Haizhou, and the Jin besieged him.
value.literal: Wei Sheng attacked Yizhou, was defeated, returned to Haizhou, and the Jin besieged it.

value.zh: 李寶以舟師至東海縣，金人解圍去，寶遂入海州。
value.en: Li Bao's fleet reached Donghai; the Jin broke the siege; Bao entered Haizhou.
value.literal: Li Bao with his fleet reached Donghai county; the Jin lifted the siege and left; Bao then entered Haizhou.

value.zh: 辛丑，金人自渦口渡淮。
value.en: On xinchou, the Jin crossed the Huai at Wokou.
value.literal: Day xinchou: Jin troops crossed the Huai from Wokou.

value.zh: 癸卯，以吳璘兼陝西、河東招討使，劉錡兼京東、河北東路招討使，成閔兼京西、河北西路招討使。
value.en: On guimao, Wu Lin also took Shaanxi and Hedong; Liu Qi Hebei East; Cheng Min Jingxi and Hebei West.
value.literal: Day guimao: Wu Lin was also made Shaanxi and Hedong pacification commissioner; Liu Qi also made Hebei East and East-Hebei pacification commissioner; Cheng Min also made Jingxi and Hebei West pacification commissioner.

value.zh: 金人陷蔣州。
value.en: The Jin took Jiang prefecture.
value.literal: Jin troops took Jiang prefecture.

value.zh: 李顯忠遣統制孔福與金人戰于大人洲，敗之。
value.en: Li Xianzhong's Kong Fu beat the Jin at Daren Islet.
value.literal: Li Xianzhong sent controller Kong Fu to fight the Jin at Daren Islet and defeated them.

value.zh: 乙巳，金人復犯海州，魏勝、李寶擊卻之。
value.en: On yisi, the Jin struck Haizhou again; Wei Sheng and Li Bao repulsed them.
value.literal: Day yisi: Jin troops again attacked Haizhou; Wei Sheng and Li Bao beat them back.

value.zh: 劉錡引兵次淮陰，金人將自清河口入淮，錡列兵于運河岸以扼之。
value.en: Liu Qi halted at Huaiyin; as the Jin aimed for Qinghe mouth, he lined the canal to block them.
value.literal: Liu Qi led troops to Huaiyin; the Jin were about to enter the Huai from Qinghe mouth; Qi arrayed troops on the canal bank to block them.

value.zh: 丁未，命宣撫制置司傳檄契丹、西夏、高麗、渤海諸國及河北、河東、陝西、京東、河南諸路，諭出師共討金人。
value.en: On dingwei day, the Pacification and Control Office was ordered to send proclamations to Khitan, Western Xia, Goryeo, Bohai, and the Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, Jingdong, and Henan circuits, instructing them to send troops and join in attacking the Jin.
value.literal: Day dingwei: the pacification and commissioner offices were ordered to proclaim to Khitan, Western Xia, Goryeo, Bohai, and the circuits of Hebei, Hedong, Shaanxi, Jingdong, and Henan, urging them to march and join in attacking the Jin.

value.zh: 是日，金人立其東京留守葛王褒為皇帝，改元大定。
value.en: That day the Jin made Eastern Capital regent Prince of Ge emperor with era Dading.
value.literal: That day, the Jin set up their Eastern Capital regent, the Prince of Ge, as emperor and changed the era name to Dad ing.

value.zh: 戊申，王權聞金兵大至，自廬州引兵遁，屯昭關。
value.en: On wushen, hearing the Jin host was vast, Wang Quan fled Luzhou to Zhaoguan.
value.literal: Day wushen: Wang Quan, hearing the Jin army was great, led troops from Luzhou in flight and camped at Zhaoguan.

value.zh: 己酉，知均州武钜招納北界杜海等二萬人來歸。
value.en: On jiyou, Jun's Wu Ju brought in Du Hai and twenty thousand northerners.
value.literal: Day jiyou: Jun prefect Wu Ju recruited Du Hai and twenty thousand others from north of the border to submit.

value.zh: 庚戌，復置機速房。
value.en: On gengxu, the Rapid-Response Office was restored.
value.literal: Day gengxu: the Rapid-Response Office was restored.

value.zh: 知廬州龔濤聞金兵將至，棄城走。
value.en: Luzhou's Gong Tao fled before the Jin arrived.
value.literal: Luzhou prefect Gong Tao, hearing the Jin would come, abandoned the city and fled.

value.zh: 辛亥，金將蕭琦陷滁州，守臣陸廉棄城走。
value.en: On xinhai, Xiao Qi took Chuzhou; Lu Lian fled.
value.literal: Day xinhai: Jin general Xiao Qi took Chuzhou; the prefect Lu Lian abandoned the city and fled.

value.zh: 壬子，改建王瑋為鎮南軍節度使。
value.en: On renzi, the Prince of Jian became Zhennan Army military commissioner.
value.literal: Day renzi: the Prince of Jian was changed to military commissioner of the Zhennan Army.

value.zh: 劉錡遣統制王剛等擊敗金人於清河口，金人復來戰，剛失利。
value.en: Liu Qi's Wang Gang beat the Jin at Qinghe mouth, then lost the rematch.
value.literal: Liu Qi sent controllers Wang Gang and others to defeat the Jin at Qinghe mouth; the Jin came again and Gang was defeated.

value.zh: 吳拱遣將侯俊、郝敦書復唐州。
value.en: Wu Gong's Hou Jun and Hao Dunshu retook Tangzhou.
value.literal: Wu Gong sent generals Hou Jun and Hao Dunshu to recover Tangzhou.

value.zh: 癸丑，借江、浙、荊湖等路坊場淨利錢三百八十萬緡以備賞軍。
value.en: On guichou, 3.8 million strings of market profit from Jiang, Zhe, and Jinghu were borrowed for rewards.
value.literal: Day guichou: three million eight hundred thousand strings of net profit from Jiang, Zhe, Jinghu, and other circuit market stalls were borrowed to fund army rewards.

value.zh: 金人圍廬州，都監、權州事楊春率兵突陣出，守水砦。
value.en: The Jin besieged Luzhou; Yang Chun broke out and held a water fort.
value.literal: Jin troops besieged Luzhou; garrison inspector and acting prefect Yang Chun led troops in a breakout and held a water fort.

value.zh: 金人又攻海州，李寶力戰敗之，解圍去。
value.en: The Jin struck Haizhou again; Li Bao fought them off and they withdrew.
value.literal: The Jin again attacked Haizhou; Li Bao fought hard and defeated them; they lifted the siege and left.

value.zh: 甲寅，金人攻樊城，吳拱遣守將翟貴、王進與戰，貴、進俱戰死，金兵亦退。
value.en: On jiayin, the Jin hit Fancheng; Zhai Gui and Wang Jin died fighting and the Jin withdrew.
value.literal: Day jiayin: Jin troops attacked Fancheng; Wu Gong sent defenders Zhai Gui and Wang Jin to fight; Gui and Jin both died in battle and the Jin also withdrew.

value.zh: 劉錡遣兵渡淮及金人戰，死者十七八。
value.en: Liu Qi's men crossed the Huai and lost seven or eight in ten.
value.literal: Liu Qi sent troops across the Huai to fight the Jin; seven or eight in ten died.

value.zh: 金主亮以大軍至廬州城北之五里，築土城以居。
value.en: Hailing camped five li north of Luzhou and threw up an earthen wall.
value.literal: The Jin ruler Hailing with his great army reached five li north of Luzhou city and built an earthen wall to dwell in.

value.zh: 戚方遣將張寶復蔣州。
value.en: Qi Fang's Zhang Bao retook Jiang prefecture.
value.literal: Qi Fang sent General Zhang Bao to recover Jiang prefecture.

value.zh: 乙卯，以金人渝盟告於天地、宗廟、社稷。
value.en: On yimao, the Jin breach was proclaimed to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars.
value.literal: Day yimao: the Jin breach of treaty was announced to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the Altars of Soil and Grain.

value.zh: 命州縣諭富民捐貲助國。
value.en: Counties were told to urge wealthy households to donate to the war effort.
value.literal: Prefectures and counties were ordered to tell wealthy households to donate funds to aid the state.

value.zh: 劉錡聞王權遁，自淮陰引兵歸揚州。
value.en: Hearing Wang Quan had run, Liu Qi pulled back from Huaiyin to Yangzhou.
value.literal: Liu Qi, hearing Wang Quan had fled, led troops from Huaiyin back to Yangzhou.

value.zh: 丙辰，金主亮入廬州，王權自昭關遁，金人追至尉子橋，破敵軍統制姚興戰死，權退保和州。
value.en: On bingchen, Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled Zhaoguan; at Weizi Bridge Yao Xing fell; Quan held Hezhou.
value.literal: Day bingchen: the Jin ruler Hailing entered Luzhou; Wang Quan fled from Zhaoguan; the Jin pursued to Weizi Bridge; Break-the-Enemy controller Yao Xing died fighting; Quan fell back to defend Hezhou.

value.zh: 金州都統制王彥遣統制任天錫出洵陽，復豐陽縣。
value.en: Wang Yan's Ren Tiansi left Xunyang and retook Fengyang.
value.literal: Jinzhou overall commander Wang Yan sent controller Ren Tiansi out of Xunyang and recovered Fengyang county.

value.zh: 丁巳，帝聞王權敗，召楊存中同宰執議於內殿，陳康伯贊帝定議親征。
value.en: On dingsi, hearing of Wang Quan's defeat, Gaozong called Yang Cunzhong and the councilors within; Chen Kangbo praised his resolve to take the field.
value.literal: Day dingsi: the Emperor, hearing Wang Quan was defeated, summoned Yang Cunzhong with the chief ministers to discuss in the inner hall; Chen Kangbo praised the Emperor for fixing on campaigning in person.

value.zh: 武钜遣將荀琛復鄧州。
value.en: Wu Ju's Xun Chen retook Dengzhou.
value.literal: Wu Ju sent General Xun Chen to recover Dengzhou.

value.zh: 戊午，任天錫復商洛縣。
value.en: On wuwu, Ren Tiansi retook Shangluo.
value.literal: Day wuwu: Ren Tiansi recovered Shangluo county.

value.zh: 命吳璘趣出兵漢中，葉義問督視江、淮軍馬，中書舍人虞允文參謀軍事。
value.en: Wu Lin was urged out of Hanzhong; Ye Yiwen oversaw Jiang and Huai; Yu Yunwen advised on the war.
value.literal: Wu Lin was ordered to hurry troops out of Hanzhong; Ye Yiwen supervised Jiang and Huai forces; Secretariat drafter Yu Yunwen joined in planning the army.

value.zh: 金人犯真州，步軍司統制邵宏淵逆戰於胥浦橋，兵敗，真州陷。
value.en: The Jin took Zhenzhou after Shao Hongyuan lost at Xupu Bridge.
value.literal: Jin troops attacked Zhenzhou; Infantry Bureau controller Shao Hongyuan met them at Xupu Bridge, was defeated, and Zhenzhou fell.

value.zh: 金人不入城，遂犯揚州。
value.en: They bypassed the city and struck Yangzhou.
value.literal: The Jin did not enter the city but then attacked Yangzhou.

value.zh: 己未，任天錫復商州，執其守完顏守能。
value.en: On jiwei, Ren Tiansi retook Shangzhou and seized Wanyan Shouneng.
value.literal: Day jiwei: Ren Tiansi recovered Shangzhou and captured its prefect Wanyan Shouneng.

value.zh: 趙撙引兵渡淮。
value.en: Zhao Zan crossed the Huai.
value.literal: Zhao Zan led troops across the Huai.

value.zh: 庚申，以楊存中為禦營宿衛使。
value.en: On gengshen, Yang Cunzhong became Palace Guard commissioner.
value.literal: Day gengshen: Yang Cunzhong was made Palace Guard commissioner.

value.zh: 趙撙復褒信縣。
value.en: Zhao Zan retook Baoxin.
value.literal: Zhao Zan recovered Baoxin county.

value.zh: 王權自和州遁歸，屯於東採石。
value.en: Wang Quan fled Hezhou to East Caishi.
value.literal: Wang Quan fled from Hezhou back and camped at East Caishi.

value.zh: 辛酉，復湯思退觀文殿大學士、充醴泉觀使兼侍讀。
value.en: On xinyou, Tang Situi was restored to Cultivating Culture academician, Sweet Spring commissioner, and Lecturer-in-Attendance.
value.literal: Day xinyou: Tang Situi was restored as Academician of the Hall for Cultivating Culture, made commissioner of the Sweet Spring Abbey and concurrent Lecturer-in-Attendance.

value.zh: 分行在官吏三之一扈從，餘留行遣常事。
value.en: A third of capital officials would accompany the Emperor; the rest kept routine business.
value.literal: One third of the mobile court's civil officials were to accompany the expedition; the rest remained to handle routine business.

value.zh: 金人陷和州。
value.en: The Jin took Hezhou.
value.literal: Jin troops took Hezhou.

value.zh: 壬戌，以將士勞於征討，避殿減膳。
value.en: On renxu, Gaozong avoided the main hall and ate sparingly for the troops' sake.
value.literal: Day renxu: because the troops were weary in campaign, the Emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.

value.zh: 劉錡退軍瓜州鎮，金人陷揚州，淮東安撫使劉澤棄城奔泰州。
value.en: Liu Qi fell back to Guazhou; the Jin took Yangzhou; Liu Ze fled to Taizhou.
value.literal: Liu Qi withdrew to Guazhou town; the Jin took Yangzhou; Huai East pacification commissioner Liu Ze abandoned the city and fled to Taizhou.

value.zh: 以戶部侍郎劉岑為禦營隨軍都轉運使，李顯忠為禦營先鋒都統制屯蕪湖，主管步軍司李捧為前軍都統制。
value.en: Liu Cen became campaign transport commissioner; Li Xianzhong vanguard commander at Wuhu; Li Peng forward-army commander.
value.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Cen was made Palace Guard campaign overall transport commissioner; Li Xianzhong was made Palace Guard vanguard overall commander and camped at Wuhu; director of the Infantry Bureau Li Peng was made forward-army overall commander.

value.zh: 趙撙復新蔡縣。
value.en: Zhao Zan retook Xincai.
value.literal: Zhao Zan recovered Xincai county.

value.zh: 癸亥，募諸州豪民招槍杖、弓箭手赴 行在。
value.en: On guihai, wealthy prefectural households were recruited to raise pikes and bows for court.
value.literal: Day guihai: wealthy men of the prefectures were recruited to raise pike and bowmen for the mobile court.

value.zh: 金人入揚州。
value.en: The Jin entered Yangzhou.
value.literal: Jin troops entered Yangzhou.

value.zh: 王權自採石夜還建康，
value.en: Wang Quan slipped back from Caishi to Jiankang by night,
value.literal: Wang Quan by night returned from Caishi to Jiankang,

value.zh: 十二月己亥朔，趙撙夜襲蔡州，復入其城。
value.en: Twelfth month, jihai new moon: Zhao Zong night-raided Cai prefecture and re-entered the city.
value.literal: Twelfth month, day jihai new moon: Zhao Zong by night raided Cai prefecture and re-entered its walls.

value.zh: 王彥遣兵復福昌縣。
value.en: Wang Yan sent troops to retake Fuchang county.
value.literal: Wang Yan sent troops to recover Fuchang county.

value.zh: 庚子，楊存中及虞允文渡江至瓜州察金兵。
value.en: On gengzi, Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed to Guazhou to scout the Jin.
value.literal: Day gengzi: Yang Cunzhong and Yu Yunwen crossed the river to Guazhou to inspect Jin troops.

value.zh: 金人犯漢南之茨湖，鄂州軍士史俊登其舟，獲一將，諸軍繼進，遂擊卻之。
value.en: The Jin struck Cihu in south Han; Ezhou soldier Shi Jun boarded a boat, captured a general, the armies followed up, and beat them back.
value.literal: The Jin attacked Cihu in south Han; Ezhou soldier Shi Jun boarded their boat, seized a general, the armies pressed on, and drove them back.

value.zh: 楊椿夜攻金人，殺其帥高定山，復廬州。
value.en: Yang Chun night-attacked the Jin, killed commander Gao Dingshan, and retook Luzhou.
value.literal: Yang Chun by night attacked the Jin, killed their commander Gao Dingshan, and recovered Luzhou.

value.zh: 辛丑，以李寶為靖海軍節度使、浙西通泰海州沿海制置使、京東東路招討使。
value.en: On xinchou, Li Bao became Jinghai military commissioner, Zhe-west coastal commissioner for Tong, Tai, and Hai, and Jing-east reconquest commissioner.
value.literal: Day xinchou: Li Bao was made military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, coastal commissioner for Zhe west and Tong, Tai, and Haizhou, and reconquest commissioner for Jing east.

value.zh: 金統軍劉萼聞茨湖敗，亦退師。
value.en: Jin commander Liu E, hearing of Cihu's defeat, also withdrew.
value.literal: Jin overall commander Liu E, hearing of the defeat at Cihu, also withdrew his army.

value.zh: 王彥遣將閻玘復澠池縣。
value.en: Wang Yan sent Yan Qi to retake Mianchi county.
value.literal: Wang Yan sent general Yan Qi to recover Mianchi county.

value.zh: 壬寅，天有白氣。
value.en: On renyin, white vapor appeared in the sky.
value.literal: Day renyin: white vapor appeared in the sky.

value.zh: 以趙密為行宮在城都總管。
value.en: Zhao Mi was made in-city traveling-palace overall commander.
value.literal: Zhao Mi was made overall commander of the traveling palace within the city.

value.zh: 成閔渡江之揚州。
value.en: Cheng Min crossed the river to Yangzhou.
value.literal: Cheng Min crossed the river to Yangzhou.

value.zh: 癸卯，命諸路招討司率兵進討，互相應援，沿江諸大帥條陳恢復事宜。
value.en: On guimao, every reconquest office was told to advance in mutual support; Yangtze commanders were to submit recovery plans.
value.literal: Day guimao: reconquest offices on every route were ordered to advance together with mutual support; great commanders along the river were to submit plans for recovery.

value.zh: 復岳州舊名。
value.en: Yue prefecture's former name was restored.
value.literal: Yue prefecture's old name was restored.

value.zh: 右軍統領沙世堅入泰州。
value.en: Right-army controller Sha Shijian entered Taizhou.
value.literal: Right-army controller Sha Shijian entered Taizhou.

value.zh: 甲辰，虞允文自鎮江入見。
value.en: On jiachen, Yu Yunwen came from Zhenjiang for audience.
value.literal: Day jiachen: Yu Yunwen from Zhenjiang had audience.

value.zh: 均州統領昝朝復鄧州。
value.en: Jun controller Zan Chao retook Deng prefecture.
value.literal: Jun prefecture controller Zan Chao recovered Deng prefecture.

value.zh: 乙巳，張浚至慈湖，命李顯忠引兵渡江。
value.en: On yisi, Zhang Jun reached Cihu and told Li Xianzhong to cross the river.
value.literal: Day yisi: Zhang Jun reached Cihu and ordered Li Xianzhong to lead troops across the river.

value.zh: 丙午，淮東統制王選復楚州。
value.en: On bingwu, Huai east controller Wang Xuan retook Chu prefecture.
value.literal: Day bingwu: Huai east controller Wang Xuan recovered Chu prefecture.

value.zh: 丁未，杜隱等入河南府。
value.en: On dingwei, Du Yin and others entered Henan prefecture.
value.literal: Day dingwei: Du Yin and others entered Henan prefecture.

value.zh: 吳拱遣統制牛宏入汝州。
value.en: Wu Gong sent controller Niu Hong into Ru prefecture.
value.literal: Wu Gong sent controller Niu Hong into Ru prefecture.

value.zh: 戊申，帝發臨安，建王從行。
value.en: On wushen, the emperor left Lin'an with the Prince of Jian.
value.literal: Day wushen: the Emperor set out from Lin'an; the Prince of Jian accompanied him.

value.zh: 庚戌，金人渡淮北去。
value.en: On gengxu, the Jin crossed north of the Huai and withdrew.
value.literal: Day gengxu: the Jin crossed north of the Huai and departed.

value.zh: 壬子，次平江。
value.en: On renzi, he stopped at Pingjiang.
value.literal: Day renzi: he halted at Pingjiang.

value.zh: 罷督視府。
value.en: The Supervisory Office was abolished.
value.literal: The Supervisory Office was abolished.

value.zh: 虞允文還至鎮江。
value.en: Yu Yunwen returned to Zhenjiang.
value.literal: Yu Yunwen returned to Zhenjiang.

value.zh: 癸丑，淮東統制劉銳、陳敏引兵入泗州。
value.en: On guichou, Huai east controllers Liu Rui and Chen Min entered Si prefecture.
value.literal: Day guichou: Huai east controllers Liu Rui and Chen Min led troops into Si prefecture.

value.zh: 鄂州統制楊欽以舟師追敗金人于洪澤鎮。
value.en: Ezhou controller Yang Qin's fleet pursued and beat the Jin at Hongze town.
value.literal: Ezhou controller Yang Qin with a fleet pursued and defeated the Jin at Hongze town.

value.zh: 乙卯，江北金兵盡去，李顯忠復入和州。
value.en: On yimao, north-of-river Jin forces were gone; Li Xianzhong re-entered He prefecture.
value.literal: Day yimao: Jin troops north of the river were all gone; Li Xianzhong re-entered He prefecture.

value.zh: 吳璘遣將復水洛城。
value.en: Wu Lin sent generals to retake Shuiluo city.
value.literal: Wu Lin sent generals to recover Shuiluo city.

value.zh: 金人復破汝州，牛宏敗走。
value.en: The Jin retook Ru prefecture; Niu Hong was routed and fled.
value.literal: The Jin again took Ru prefecture; Niu Hong was beaten and fled.

value.zh: 戊午，次鎮江府。
value.en: On wuwu, he stopped at Zhenjiang.
value.literal: Day wuwu: he halted at Zhenjiang prefecture.

value.zh: 庚申，吳璘遣將拔金人治平砦。
value.en: On gengshen, Wu Lin's generals stormed the Jin Zhiping fort.
value.literal: Day gengshen: Wu Lin sent generals to storm the Jin's Zhiping fort.

value.zh: 壬戌，曲赦新復州軍。
value.en: On renxu, newly recovered prefectures and armies received a partial pardon.
value.literal: Day renxu: newly recovered prefectures and armies received a partial amnesty.

value.zh: 甲子，降淮南、京西、湖北雜犯死罪以下囚。
value.en: On jiazi, death sentences and lesser crimes in Huainan, Jing west, and Hubei were commuted.
value.literal: Day jiazi: death sentences and below for miscellaneous offenses in Huainan, Jing west, and Hubei were reduced.

value.zh: 賞採石功，進統制張振、時俊等官。
value.en: Caishi victors were rewarded; controllers Zhang Zhen, Shi Jun, and others were promoted.
value.literal: Caishi merit was rewarded; controllers Zhang Zhen, Shi Jun, and others were advanced in rank.

value.zh: 金潁、壽二州巡檢高顯以壽春府來降。
value.en: Jin patrol inspectors Gao Xian of Ying and Shou surrendered Shouchun prefecture.
value.literal: Jin patrol inspectors Gao Xian of Ying and Shou prefectures surrendered Shouchun prefecture.

value.zh: 丁卯，命諸道籍鄉兵。
value.en: On dingmao, every route was told to register militia.
value.literal: Day dingmao: every route was ordered to register militia.

value.zh: 初，王友直、王任聚兵，嘗命友直為天雄軍節度使，任為天平軍節度使。
value.en: Earlier Wang Youzhi and Wang Ren had raised forces; Youzhi was made Tianxiong commissioner and Ren Tianping commissioner.
value.literal: Earlier Wang Youzhi and Wang Ren had gathered troops; Youzhi had been made military commissioner of the Tianxiong Army and Ren of the Tianping Army.

value.zh: 金主褒既立，下令散其眾，友直等自壽春來歸。
value.en: After Jin Emperor Shizong enthroned, he ordered their bands broken up; Youzhi and others came in from Shouchun.
value.literal: After Jin Emperor Shizong took the throne, he ordered their bands dispersed; Youzhi and the rest came in from Shouchun.

value.zh: 是月，金主知亮已死，遂趨燕京。
value.en: That month, learning Hailing was dead, the Jin emperor hurried to Yanjing.
value.literal: That month, learning Hailing was dead, the Jin ruler hurried to Yanjing.

value.zh: 嗚呼！
value.en: Alas!
value.literal: Alas!

value.zh: 自唐失其政，天下乘時，黥髡盜販，袞冕峨巍。
value.en: Once Tang lost hold of government, the whole world seized its chance: branded felons and traffickers in stolen goods donned court robes and caps as grand as any emperor's.
value.literal: From the time Tang lost proper governance, the realm seized the moment; tattooed convicts and bandit peddlers wore ceremonial caps and robes towering high.

value.zh: 吳暨南唐，奸豪竊攘。
value.en: In Wu and Southern Tang alike, ruthless adventurers stole the realm for themselves.
value.literal: Wu and Southern Tang—villainous strongmen seized power through theft and usurpation.

value.zh: 蜀險而富，漢險而貧，貧能自強，富者先亡。
value.en: Shu was rugged and rich, Han rugged and poor; poverty could steel a state to endure, while wealth invited ruin first.
value.literal: Shu was perilous yet wealthy; Han was perilous yet poor. Poverty could drive self-strengthening; the wealthy perished first.

value.zh: 閩陋荊蹙，楚開蠻服。
value.en: Min was mean and hemmed in, Jing pressed tight on every side, while Chu opened the frontier and brought the southern tribes to heel.
value.literal: Min was crude and cramped; Jing was constrained; Chu opened the land and brought the barbarians to submission.

value.zh: 剝剽弗堪，吳越其尤。
value.en: Extortion and plunder grew unbearable, and none suffered more than Wu and Yue.
value.literal: Extortion and plunder were unbearable; Wu and Yue were worst of all.

value.zh: 牢牲視人，嶺蜑遭劉。
value.en: Men were penned like beasts awaiting slaughter, and the Dan boat people of the Ling country fell victim to the Liu clan.
value.literal: Penned sacrificial beasts looked upon men; the Dan of the Ling region suffered under Liu.

value.zh: 百年之間，並起爭雄，山川亦絕，風氣不通。
value.en: Within a single century they all rose at once to vie for supremacy, until mountains and rivers were cut off from one another and no common culture could pass between them.
value.literal: Within a hundred years, rivals rose together vying for supremacy; mountains and rivers were cut off, and customs could not flow between regions.

value.zh: 語曰：清風興，群陰伏；
value.en: As the saying has it: when the clear wind rises, every shadow retreats;
value.literal: The saying goes: when the clear wind rises, all yin shades subside;

value.zh: 日月出，爝火息。
value.en: when sun and moon appear, the torch's flicker goes out.
value.literal: when sun and moon emerge, torch-flame dies.

value.zh: 故真人作而天下同。
value.en: And so when the true sovereign arises, the realm is united as one.
value.literal: Therefore when the true lord appears, the realm becomes one.

value.zh: 作《十國世家》。
value.en: Hence I wrote the 《Hereditary Houses of the Ten Kingdoms》.
value.literal: I composed the 《Hereditary Houses of the Ten Kingdoms》.

value.zh: 溫雖奸詐多疑，而善用將吏。
value.en: Treacherous and suspicious though he was, Wen knew how to use generals and officials.
value.literal: Though Wen was treacherous and suspicious, he knew well how to use generals and clerks.

value.zh: 江西劉信圍虔州，久不克，使人說譚全播出降，遣使報溫，溫怒曰：「信以十倍之眾，攻一城不下，而反用說客降之，何以威敵國？」
value.en: Liu Xin of Jiangxi besieged Qianzhou for months without success and sent envoys to coax Tan Quanbo into surrender. When Xin reported this to Wen, Wen raged, "With ten times the force you cannot take one city, yet you hire talkers to win surrender—how will that awe our enemies?"
value.literal: Liu Xin of Jiangxi besieged Qianzhou long without taking it and sent men to persuade Tan Quanbo to surrender, then dispatched an envoy to report to Wen. Wen said in anger: "Xin with ten times the force cannot take one city, yet turns to persuaders to secure surrender—how can he awe enemy states?"

value.zh: 笞其使者而遣之，曰：「吾以笞信也。」
value.en: He had the envoy flogged and sent back, saying, "This lash is meant for Xin."
value.literal: He flogged the envoy and sent him back, saying: "I flog him to flog Xin."

value.zh: 因命濟師，遂破全播。
value.en: He ordered reinforcements and Quanbo was taken.
value.literal: He then ordered reinforcements and thus broke Quanbo.

value.zh: 人有誣信逗留陰縱全播，言信將反者，信聞之，因自獻捷至金陵見溫，溫與信博，信斂骰子厲聲祝曰：「劉信欲背吳，願為惡彩，茍無二心，當成渾花。」
value.en: Someone accused Xin of stalling and secretly aiding Quanbo, saying he meant to rebel. Xin came to Jinling with news of victory and gambled with Wen. Gathering the dice he prayed aloud, "If I mean to betray Wu, let me throw ill; if my heart is loyal, let every die show red."
value.literal: Someone slandered Xin, saying he lingered and secretly let Quanbo go and that Xin would rebel. Xin heard of it and therefore came of his own accord with news of victory to Jinling to see Wen. Wen gambled with Xin; Xin gathered the dice and prayed in a harsh voice: "If Liu Xin wishes to betray Wu, may I throw an ill cast; if I have no second heart, may I throw a full red."

value.zh: 溫遽止之，一擲，六子皆赤，溫慚，自以卮酒飲信，然終疑之。
value.en: Wen tried to stop him, but with one throw all six dice came up red. Ashamed, Wen shared a cup with him—yet he never quite trusted him again.
value.literal: Wen hastily stopped him, but with one throw all six were red. Wen was ashamed and drank a goblet with Xin himself, yet in the end still doubted him.

value.zh: 及唐師伐王衍，溫急召信至廣陵，以為左統軍，托以內備，遂奪其地。
value.en: When Tang marched against Wang Yan, Wen summoned Xin to Guangling, made him Left Commander-in-Chief on the pretext of guarding the capital, and stripped him of his command in Jiangxi.
value.literal: When Tang troops campaigned against Wang Yan, Wen urgently summoned Xin to Guangling, made him Left Commander-in-Chief on the pretext of internal defense, and thus seized his territory.
